test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 17 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
The following graph shows the number of tickets sold by 6 students P, Q, R, S, T and U during a fair. What percent of the total tickets were sold by Q, S and U? 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/40e5162327952b877cb4ffa316610435567ec11aad74c85501b53bbbabad5f87.png]
solution:
**Calculation**

The number of tickets sold by 6 students P, Q, R, S, T and U during a fair = 18 + 14 + 5 + 16 + 15 + 8

⇒ 76

The total tickets were sold by Q, S and U = 14 + 16 + 8 = 38

⇒ (38 / 76) × 100

⇒ 50%

**∴ Percent of ticket sold is 50%. **
